name: Blood Courts
worldbuilding: Vampiric dynasties and supernatural aristocracies supported by enthralled mortals, elite retainers, and monstrous predators. They rely on aggressive melee combat, speed, and replenishing themselves through killing.

factionRule.name: Feast on the Fallen
factionRule.effect: Once per Round, after a friendly Unit defeats an enemy Model in Engagement, Heal 1 Damage from that Unit.

factionCommands.name: Blood Frenzy
factionCommands.effect: When the active Unit makes a Melee Attack against an enemy Unit that has already lost at least one Model or has accumulated unsaved Damage, gain +1 Attack die per surviving Model, maximum +4 Attack dice, on that Attack. Add these dice once to the combined Unit pool.

factionCommands.name: Predatory Speed
factionCommands.effect: Reaction: After a friendly Unit destroys an enemy Unit, choose that victorious Unit or one other friendly Unit within Short (6") of it. The chosen Unit may Move up to 2", ending legally. This is not a free Disengage or another activation.

factionCommands.name: Mesmerize
factionCommands.effect: Reaction: When an enemy Unit within Short (6") of a friendly Unique Unit declares an Attack against that Unique Unit, worsen the enemy’s Hit by one step for that triggering Attack only.

factionCommands.name: Cut Off the Leaders
factionCommands.effect: For the active Unit's next eligible Attack this Phase, choose one of these battlefield-role counters: Anti-Hero 4 or Anti-Officer 4. The active Unit gains the selected Anti-tag 4 for its next eligible Attack against a Unit actually bearing the matching tag this Round. Applicable Anti ranks never add; use the highest. This is one CP-powered Command and cannot stack with another friendly Command on the same Attack.

abilities.name: Predatory
abilities.effect: After destroying an enemy Unit, Move up to 1", ending legally.

abilities.name: Frenzied Mass
abilities.effect: While this Unit contains at least six surviving Models, Blades gains +1 Attack per contributing Model (2 Attacks per Model rather than 1). The bonus is lost when reduced below six Models.

abilities.name: Relentless Hunt
abilities.effect: The Unit has Impact +2 on successful Charges. This printed value replaces the previous Impact +1 from Relentless Hunt; it is not an additional +1.

abilities.name: Pack Hunters
abilities.effect: After this Unit destroys an enemy Model, it may immediately Move up to 1", ending legally.

abilities.name: Surround the Prey
abilities.effect: When this Unit makes a Melee Attack against an enemy also Engaged by a different friendly Unit, Twin Fangs improve Hit from 5+ to 4+ for that Attack. This does not grant additional Attacks.

abilities.name: Challenge Prey
abilities.effect: Choose one enemy Unique Unit within Short. The Vampire Captain's next Melee Attack against it gains Critical 1.

abilities.name: Blood Drain
abilities.effect: Inflict Direct Damage 1 on one enemy within Short. If the Damage is not prevented, Heal 1 on the Sorcerer.

abilities.name: Call Retainers
abilities.effect: Add one matching basic Model to a surviving, unengaged friendly Thrall or generic Line Infantry Unit within Short, to a maximum of starting size +2 Models. Place legally in Coherency; no free activation.

optionalUpgrades.name: Specialized Guidance
optionalUpgrades.effect: At list construction choose one existing creature/material Trait tag. Other friendly Units wholly within 3" gain Anti-[that tag] 2. Highest applicable Anti rank only. This is a passive aura, not a free Command; does not benefit its source.

abilities.name: Predatory Dive
abilities.effect: When Charging from an elevated position, gain +1 Impact and Accurate 1 on its next Attack.

abilities.name: Soul Furnace
abilities.effect: Once per Round, when a friendly Unit within Short destroys an enemy Unit, the Coach may Move 2" without finishing Engaged.

abilities.name: Master Predator
abilities.effect: The first time each Round the Regent defeats a unit or removes a model from a unit, Heal 1.

abilities.name: Nightfall Hunt
abilities.effect: Up to two friendly Units within Medium each immediately Move 2" and gain +1 Attack per Model during their next Combat activation this Round.

genericUnitsWorthTaking: Cheap mortal infantry, archers, Medics, Scouts, and Light Cavalry. The expensive Blood Knights cannot efficiently cover all of an army's mobile or objective-control needs.
designNotes: v4.2 balance pass: added Night Stalkers as the faction's Extra Core, a mobile lifesteal-skirmisher Infiltrating unit reinforcing the aggressive/predatory identity rather than patching a weakness. Thralls' weapon profile was kept unchanged (Models, not Attacks, is this faction's established horde-buff pattern). Other Damage-1 weapons gained +1 Attack; Damage-2+ weapons kept their Attacks and gained a thematic Anti-[Type] (Anti-Infantry on Blood Lances and the Black Coach's Scythes, Anti-Elite on the Vampire Captain's Noble Blade, Anti-Unique on the Winged Horror's Fangs and Talons, Anti-Monster on the Crimson Regent's Blood Sovereign's Blade).
